summary: Preview of the Week 16 Saturday game between the Buffalo Bills (8-6) and the Los Angeles Chargers (5-9) at SoFi Stadium, with betting odds, trends, props and a pick. The Bills are 12-point favorites riding James Cook's big rushing game, while the Chargers fired Brandon Staley and Tom Telesco after a 63-21 loss to the Raiders and are led by interim coach Giff Smith. The writer picks the Bills and suggests two props: Dalton Kincaid UNDER receptions and Gerald Everett OVER receiving yards.
one_line: Sporting News previews Bills vs. Chargers in Week 16 2023, with Buffalo 12-point favorites, betting trends, two props, and a pick of the Bills.
key_facts: The Bills (8-6) are 12-point favorites over the Chargers (5-9) with the OVER/UNDER set at 44 for the Week 16 Saturday game at SoFi Stadium.
Giff Smith, the Chargers' interim head coach, faces the Bills in his first game in charge.
Buffalo trails three other 8-6 teams (Bengals, Colts, Texans) by tiebreakers in the AFC wild card hunt.
The Bills beat the Cowboys 31-10 in Week 15; James Cook rushed 25 times for 179 yards and 1 TD and was named AFC Offensive Player of the Week.
Before Week 15, James Cook had not rushed more than 17 times in a game; backup Ty Johnson suffered a shoulder injury in Week 15.
Buffalo is 6-7-1 ATS in 2023, went 0 covers during a six-game stretch from Weeks 5-10, and is on a 3-0-1 ATS streak.
The Chargers lost 63-21 to the Raiders on Thursday Night Football, leading to the firing of head coach Brandon Staley and GM Tom Telesco.

Justin Herbert is out for the season with a hand injury; replacement Easton Stick went 23-for-32 for 257 yards and a TD in Week 15 but had a fumble return and interception return against him within about 25 seconds.
The Chargers are 4-9-1 ATS, have failed to cover in five of their last six games, and have gone under in 10 of 12 games.
Buffalo has averaged 29 PPG in its last four games, making the total of 44 look low to the writer.
Prop pick: Dalton Kincaid UNDER receptions, as he was limited in practice Wednesday with a shoulder injury and is expected to play at less than 100%.
Prop pick: Gerald Everett OVER receiving yards; he has had 41, 39, 44 and 43 receiving yards in his last four games.
The final pick is the Bills.
